physicalNotes: No radius or mass of NGC 4639 is recorded: it is an extended galaxy, and its package frames it at 8100 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM): RC3's isophotal diameter, log D25 = 1.44 (0.1 arcmin), halved and set at the Cepheid distance.

sources.position: HyperLEDA meandata (Makarov et al. 2014, A&A 570, A13; http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/), PGC 42741: al2000 12.7145558 h, de2000 13.2572415 deg
sources.distance: Riess et al. (2016), ApJ 826, 56, table 5 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.01424), row N4639: Cepheid distance modulus mu_Ceph 31.532 +/- 0.071 mag, 10^(mu/5 + 1) pc: 20248833 pc (-651363/+673013); the distance its Cepheids are placed at
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
